name: Jorge Baltra
body:
I still can’t believe that my dear friend Paul has passed away. When I arrived in Burlington, Vermont, he welcomed me like a brother. His warmth was extraordinary. I’ll never forget how he would ask everyone around us not to speak to me in Spanish, he did it just to help me learn the language. He was always thinking of others. His generosity, his joy, his incredible energy… they lit up every place he was in. My deepest condolences to his wife and family. May God bless them… I’m sure he’s already in heaven, playing music and making hummus, two of the things he was most passionate about.

With love,
Your Chilean friend, 🇨🇱
Jorge.
